rule: A clientId may belong to one authority group only. Each entry records an existing conflict that needs an external owner decision; the compiler rejects any unrecorded conflict and any entry that no longer conflicts.

conflicts.reason: observability declares Superset's browser login client and openbao-workload-identity declares a service-account machine identity under the same clientId; Keycloak keeps one client per clientId, so whichever staging reconciler runs second overwrites the other.
conflicts.decisionOwner: identity owner with the OpenBao and observability owners
conflicts.requiredDecision: rename one identity: the OpenBao azp binding lives in the pinned OpenBao workload-secret authority, the browser clientId in Superset's runtime login configuration
